verdict.rationale: Linear can be driven without its UI. It offers a GraphQL API with personal API keys and OAuth2, a typed TypeScript SDK, webhooks, and published rate limits, so CI scripts and automation jobs can query and mutate data headlessly. Its Loops feature also runs agent jobs in the cloud on a schedule or in response to events. However, nothing shows a dedicated way to run Linear in CI, so pipelines must be scripted by hand against the API or SDK. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, a first-party CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Action) or CI-specific docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI automation use.
